Plasteel Plating is a Titan-exclusive material in Destiny. It can be obtained by dismantling uncommon or higher rarity Titan armor. Plasteel Plating is used to upgrade rare or higher Titan armor. After the release of The Taken King, these materials were no longer used and were replaced by Armor Materials. Guardians' existing Plasteel Plating can be traded for Armor Materials by Roni 55-30.
Radegast's Fury is a legendary rocket launcher. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Weapon Parts, and Legendary Marks.

Rarity indicates the quality of a particular item, such as a weapon, armor piece, or shader. There are five levels of rarity, each distinguishable by the color of the item icon background: #Common (white) #Uncommon (green) #Rare (blue) #Legendary (purple) #Exotic (gold) Though players may carry as many exotic items as they like in their inventory, only one exotic armor piece and one exotic weapon may be equipped at the same time. Exceptions are armor pieces with the "The Life Exotic" perk, which allows them to be equipped with another exotic.
The Queen's Guard Plate is a legendary Titan chest armor rewarded after completing specific missions during The Queen's Wrath event.
Praedyth's Revenge is a legendary sniper rifle. It can be obtained as a random loot drop in the Vault of Glass raid.
Queen's Guard Robes is a legendary Warlock chest armor piece. It can be obtained from a Queen's Blessing reputation package.
Perun's Fire is a legendary fusion rifle that can be purchased from Lord Saladin during the Iron Banner Crucible event.
Queen's Guard Greaves is a legendary Titan leg armor. It is only obtainable during The Queen's Wrath.

Pulse Rifle Telemetry is a consumable that increases the experience gained towards pulse rifles for 30 minutes. Prior to Destiny: The Taken King, they could be purchased from Xûr or from dismantling upgraded legendary pulse rifles. After The Taken King, they were replaced by Primary Telemetry.
Queen's Guard Hood is a legendary Warlock helmet and is part of the armor set.
Prime Zealot Cuirass is a legendary Hunter chest armor. It is obtained randomly by completing a phase of the Vault of Glass.
Praedyth's Timepiece is a legendary pulse rifle. It can be obtained by completing the Vault of Glass.
Prudence II is a legendary New Monarchy sniper rifle. It can be obtained by decrypting engrams.
The Queen's Guard Helm is a legendary Titan helmet rewarded after completing specific missions during The Queen's Wrath event.
Praetorian Foil is a legendary fusion rifle. It can only be obtained as a loot drop during the level 30 Vault of Glass.

Purifier VII is a legendary New Monarchy fusion rifle that cannot be purchased. It can be earned as a random completion reward such as completing the Weekly Nightfall Strike or obtained in New Monarchy packages after leveling up your New Monarchy rank.
Raku Vindicator is legendary Hunter leg armor. It was added in The Dark Below and is part of the Raku Vindicator armor set.

Queen's Guard Gloves are legendary gauntlets able to be wielded by Warlocks. Queen's Guard Gloves can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Armor Materials, and Legendary Marks. It can also be transferred to other characters through the vault.

Queen's Guard Grips are legendary gauntlets able to be wielded by Hunters. Queen's Guard Grips can be dismantled to generate Glimmer, Armor Materials, and Legendary Marks. It can also be transferred to other characters through the vault.
Primed Big Sky Mk.48 is a rare hand cannon. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer and Weapon Parts.
Primed Starfall MSc is a rare pulse rifle. It can be dismantled to generate Glimmer and Weapon Parts.
